## Unused loop iteration variable For loop variable character is not used in the loop body. --- General fix: when a loop iteration variable is intentionally unused, replace the loop form so no unused binding is created, while preserving semantics.

Best fix here: in scripts/candidate-homepage.mjs, inside fitsPullBody, change the for (const character of body) loop to for (const _ of body) (or equivalent) to indicate intentional discard and satisfy static analysis without changing logic. This keeps Unicode-aware iteration over code points and preserves the early return when exceeding maxBodyCharacters.

No new imports, methods, or dependencies are needed.

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused variable character. --- To fix this without changing functionality, keep counting Unicode code points via string iteration but remove the unused loop variable binding.

Best change in scripts/candidate-homepage.mjs:

  • In fitsPullBody, replace:
    • for (const character of body) { ... }
  • With:
    • for (const _ of body) { ... }

Using _ is a conventional placeholder for intentionally unused bindings, satisfies static analysis in typical configurations, and preserves exact behavior and performance characteristics of the current logic.

No imports, helper methods, or additional definitions are needed.
